issues.on_page: Grant income 11,250 (Water Fund, nonoperating; Capital Grants and Contributions on p3)
issues.issue: A grant line whose label isn't other/miscellaneous was put in `other`. The grantor isn't printed. FY2023/FY2024 put the same label in intergovernmental/state aid and FY2025 in federal grants, so the categories differ from year to year.
FY2025 asks the user (decision_needed) whether Water Fund 'Grant income' is federal or state; FY2022 has no decision_needed entry for the same question.

issues.on_page: Grants and contributions 32,654 (p3: Capital Grants and Contributions, public works)
issues.issue: Mixed grants/contributions label kept as donations/contributions. The source isn't stated; it could be a government capital grant. This is a judgment call (it already has a review note).

Not labelled 'Capital Outlay: <function>' as the user's rule asks, because the line covers two funds/functions (General Fund capital outlay sits in General government in the budget schedule; Street Fund is streets). Defensible, but it is not the standard label.
